cohort: Pregnant women from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project-Nationwide Inpatient Sample (HCUP-NIS) database
finding: Prenatal smoking was associated with a significantly higher risk of PTB, preterm premature rupture of membranes, and SGA neonates, but a lower risk of preeclampsia, chorioamnionitis, PPH, and operative vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Prenatal smoking was associated with a lower risk of operative vaginal delivery.
